services.name: Permanent Exhibits
services.desc: A tribute to the city of Birmingham’s 99 neighborhoods, The 99 is an exhibit that preserves and honors the collective memory of the Magic City. We invite you to join us on July 31st for the opening reception of The 99, in our Woolfolk Gallery. The exhibit is curated by Birmingham native Emily Rice and features pieces from her original exhibits 99 Neighborhoods I & II, including 99 miniature wooden sculptures of homes that correspond in scale and character with each neighborhood. Rice also sourced sediment, soil, and vegetation from each neighborhood, converting them into art materials included in the exhibit. Join us on July 31st for an evening of art and reflection. Doors will open at 5:00

services.name: Space Rentals
services.desc: The Birmingham Civil Rights Institute (BCRI) makes an exciting back-drop to host your next event. One of Birmingham’s unique treasures, BCRI is conveniently located in the Historic Civil Rights District of Birmingham, Alabama. Its surroundings include Kelly Ingram Park, Sixteenth Street Baptist Church, and the A.G. Gaston Motel. Planning your event at BCRI is an excellent way to introduce your guests to the wonderful galleries and exciting programs offered at BCRI. We encourage you to include time during your event for guests to view current exhibitions. Special tours or experiences in the galleries can be arranged for additional fees. Proceeds from special events fees help BCRI to continue

services.name: School Field Trips
services.desc: School field trip reservations must be made by a K-12 school administrator or educator and are available September through May.Please note that BCRI visits are best suited for students in 3rd grade and above.We recommend booking field trips at least 30 days in advance.Field Trip Pricing Grades 4-12: $10 per student

services.name: A Night With Legacy in Banking
services.desc: Night with Legacy brings together leaders from long-standing Black-owned businesses to share their stories and impact on the community. This conversation will unpack the decisions that shape what comes next, from banking relationships and succession planning to ownership, growth, and preserving the legacy you’ve worked so hard to build. This panel discussion is hosted by Network Navigator, presented by Prosper, at the BCRI. Come ready for an honest conversation with leaders who have helped businesses navigate the moments that matter
